title: StrategyQA question record (uncertainty study)
description: One question of the StrategyQA set (multi-step commonsense) used by thesis Objectives 1-2. Mirrors the Item dataclass in uncertainty/sets/load.py.
x-format: JSON Lines: one JSON object per line, each matching this schema
x-source: ChilleD/StrategyQA (test) + official facts/decompositions from voidful/StrategyQA strategyqa_train.json
x-note: Documentation only: no code reads this schema.

id.description: Unique question id in this set: 'sqa-' + the source dataset's own id.

set.description: Name of the question set: always 'strategyqa'.

kind.description: Answer kind 'yesno': yes or no, read and graded by rules.

question.description: The question as sent to the model.

split.description: Fixed, seeded split: dev (30%) only tunes thresholds and trains the Objective 2 models; every reported number uses test (70%).

core.description: true if the question is in the core tier, the subset every model answers; the file itself is the extended tier.

judge_mode.description: How the LLM judge grades a free-text answer: match (agrees with a reference answer), truthfulqa (TruthfulQA judge prompt), abstain (correct only if it says the question cannot be answered), premise (correct only if it rejects the false premise). Unused for rule-graded kinds.

incorrect_answers.description: Known false answers from the dataset (TruthfulQA only; empty elsewhere).

gold_type.description: Always null: the dataset gives no uncertainty type for these questions.

evidence.description: The official supporting facts for the question, joined. Used only by the Objective 2 knowledge intervention.

hint.description: 'Break the question into steps: (1) ... (2) ...' from the official decomposition; null when it has fewer than 2 steps. Used only by the Objective 2 reasoning intervention.

term.description: The Wikipedia term the question was written from.

meta.description: Extra fields kept from the source dataset (for strata and analysis).

examples.question: Does water have viscosity?
examples.evidence: Viscosity is resistance of fluid to deformation. Water is not resistant to deformation.
examples.hint: Break the question into steps: (1) What is viscosity? (2) Is water #1?
